description: This file defines the EqualBinary class in the Twig templating engine, specifically handling the equality comparison operation between two expressions in the expression node hierarchy.

classes.name: EqualBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary equality operator node within Twig's expression AST, compiling PHP code to evaluate whether two expressions are equal.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to perform the equality check, with a conditional for PHP version differences.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string '==' as the operator representation in the generated code.
